cues.text: Hey Jim, it’s Peter.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Oh hey Peter. What’s up?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: I thought I’d call so we could hammer out the details for next year’s lease.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: That’s a good idea. Did we ever decide on how to split the total rent?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Well, I was thinking since my room is bigger I probably should pay a little more, so I could pay £110 and you could pay £80. Does that sound okay?
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Considering that my old apartment cost me £100 for a smaller room, I’m definitely alright with that! Hey, I was looking at a map of the area, and can’t seem to find a bus stop near it. Do you know where we would catch the bus?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Well, the bus is actually pretty far from us, but we have that garage that we can park out cars in.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Wow, that’s great! Convenient parking is hard to find, so we’re lucky we have that. Okay, so we have a whole lot of things we’ll need to buy when we move in - how do you want to split that up?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: I was wondering - do you still work at the supermarket?
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Yep, every Tuesday and Saturday.
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Would you be able to buy things from there if I send you a shopping list?
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Sure, I can do that.
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Great. Then I can take care of whatever else we need that you wouldn’t get at a supermarket. If you want, I’ll pick you up from work that day and we can go to the apartment together.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: That would be great, thanks.
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: No problem - that way we can split the cost of petrol.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Works for me. It’s so expensive these days, isn’t it?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: It’s downright obscene.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: So let’s figure out what appliances we need. Do we have a microwave?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Yes, the landlord’s providing that for us. Hey, do you still have that space heater though? We need one for the kitchen since it’s not connected to the central heating.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Oh, right, I’ll bring that. Anything else?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Well, I have some dining room and living room furniture I can bring, so that should take care of most of the big stuff. You know what we do need though? Could you bring a toaster?
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: I actually don’t have one. It doesn’t come with the microwave?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: No, the landlord is only supplying the microwave. It would really help if you could bring one.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Okay, I’ll pick one up at the store. You know, I also have this cool antique rotary phone that would be a cool addition to the apartment. Sort of as decoration and utility.
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Oh cool! The only thing is, we’d have to put it in the kitchen, unless you want it in your room.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Why not put it in the living room?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: The living room is too loud to have a phone conversation. The noise sort of carries, so if one person is trying to watch TV or have friends over the person on the phone won’t be able to hear.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Hm, okay, well I guess kitchen it is then. Any other big things we need? That seems like everything
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: That’s all I can think of. And of course, move-in is
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: June 1st. I can’t wait. We’ll be able to watch the big game in our new apartment - it’s going to be awesome!
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: Yeah, we can move in in the morning and then Friday night we can sit back and cheer on Liverpool.
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: I have an exam in the morning, but will be done around 11 a.m. and can move in after. Wait...  Liverpool? You’re joking, right? I thought you were a Manchester United fan?
cues.speaker: Jim

cues.text: MAN U? No way! Liverpool all the way!
cues.speaker: Peter

cues.text: Oh no. I don’t know if I can live with a Liverpool fan...
cues.speaker: Jim
